top_findings: sitemap.xml returns HTTP 403 while robots.txt returns HTTP 200
quick_wins: Review Cloudflare and LiteSpeed access rules
Allow stable 200 delivery to approved crawlers
Restore sitemap.xml with valid XML and HTTP 200
Re-run the full audit after access is fixed

findings.title: Canonical homepage inaccessible
findings.description: HTTPS apex and www homepage requests returned HTTP 403.
findings.recommendation: Fix WAF/origin rules and verify stable 200 crawler delivery.

findings.title: Homepage content unavailable
findings.description: No indexable homepage HTML was available for content assessment.
findings.recommendation: Re-run after the origin returns HTTP 200.

findings.title: On-page elements unavailable
findings.description: Title, meta description, headings, canonical, and links could not be verified.

findings.title: Structured data unavailable
findings.description: No valid homepage HTML or JSON-LD was retrieved.
findings.recommendation: Validate JSON-LD after a stable 200 response.

findings.title: Performance unavailable
findings.description: The renderer stopped at the HTTP 403 response; no LCP, INP, or CLS data was collected.
findings.recommendation: Run lab and field performance checks after access is fixed.

findings.title: Crawler retrieval blocked
findings.description: AI/search crawlers may receive the same HTTP 403 as the audit renderer.
findings.recommendation: Test named crawlers and compare their HTML with a browser response after the WAF fix.

findings.title: Images unavailable
findings.description: No indexable homepage content was retrieved for image analysis.
findings.recommendation: Re-run image analysis after access is restored.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Create recommendations from verified content and business signals

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monitor crawler status and sitemap availability
Capture drift baseline after stable delivery
